summaries.Romania: Romania faces critical infrastructure challenges with both Cernavodă reactors offline and political tensions rising over territorial reform, while EU relations remain strained amid press freedom concerns. Energy prices soar despite nuclear production, and internal party conflicts intensify across PNL and other opposition groups.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with gene therapy risks materializing, GLP-1 drug safety warnings emerging, and AI-driven clinical tools expanding across health systems, while workforce challenges persist amid medication shortages and mental health concerns.
summaries.Tech: AI safety and national security intersect as Nvidia's CEO faces investigation over alleged Chinese espionage, while major players like Anthropic, Claude, and Meta race to deploy more capable models and agents amid mounting concerns over responsible deployment.

items.line: Both Cernavodă reactors failing repeatedly signals systemic technical and management failures that undermine Romania's energy independence and grid stability.

items.title: STAT+: FDA warns GLP-1 drugs carry potential risk of rare eye condition
items.snippet: The FDA on Monday warned that GLP-1 drugs carry a potential risk for a rare but serious eye condition that's sometimes referred to as an "eye stroke."
items.line: FDA's warning that GLP-1 drugs carry risk of rare eye condition ('eye stroke') marks a critical safety signal for the fastest-growing weight-loss and diabetes drug class.

items.title: STAT+: Gene therapy’s long-debated cancer risk materializes
items.snippet: For years, gene therapy researchers debated whether the viruses they use to ferry replacement genes into cells could cause tumors. A small number of cases now offer strong evidence that…
items.line: Gene therapy's theoretical cancer risk is now materializing in real cases, forcing the field to confront a long-debated safety tradeoff that could reshape clinical protocols.

items.title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy

items.line: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens national security and complicates the company's critical role in AI infrastructure.
